# Kickoff for Automated Berth Coordination

Date: 2023-12-10  
Attendees: Odalys Naskdale, Oriel Fennvane, Nadezhda Ibbton  

## Agenda  
- Introduce the Automated Berth Coordination pilot project  
- Define ownership and responsibilities  
- Review data integration requirements for vessel tracking and berth assignments  
- Set initial targets and timelines  

## Discussion  
The kickoff meeting officially launched the Automated Berth Coordination pilot on 2023-12-10. Odalys Naskdale was assigned as the project owner and will oversee all phases through the initial deployment. The pilot aims to integrate real-time vessel tracking telemetry with berth scheduling to reduce average berth wait times by 15% within the first 3 months.  

Nadezhda Ibbton presented preliminary data from the vessel tracking system, showing that average ship arrival deviations currently vary up to ±45 minutes. The pilot will prioritize improving berth assignment accuracy by leveraging vessel ETA updates every 10 minutes. Oriel Fennvane highlighted the need to incorporate crane telemetry data for better synchronization between berth availability and container handling readiness.  

Key data points identified:  
- Vessel position updates every 10 minutes via AIS telemetry feed  
- Current berth occupancy rate averaging 87% during peak hours (06:00–18:00)  
- Target berth turnaround reduction from 48 hours to 41 hours per vessel  

The team agreed that the pilot scope will cover two terminals: East Bay Terminal and Harbor Central Pier. Both terminals handle an average of 25 vessels per week.  

## Decisions  
- Odalys Naskdale appointed as pilot project owner  
- Pilot start date confirmed as 2023-12-10  
- Scope limited to East Bay Terminal and Harbor Central Pier initially  
- Integration to include vessel tracking and crane telemetry data streams  

## Action Items  
- Odalys: Draft detailed project plan and milestone schedule by 2023-12-15  
- Nadezhda: Prepare data ingestion pipeline for vessel tracking telemetry by 2023-12-20  
- Oriel: Coordinate with crane operations to enable telemetry integration by 2023-12-22  
- All: Schedule weekly check-in meetings starting 2023-12-17 to monitor progress
